title: terrain.structural_integrity_low
description: M14E warning emitted when a chunk's `structural_integrity_field` drops below the L1 locked threshold (200) for at least one cell. Drives the L1 ceiling crack decal + `tunnel_creak` audio cue + 'STRUCTURAL WARNING — ceiling unstable' HUD banner.

chunk_id.description: Chunk coordinate as [cx, cy] in chunk-space.

min_integrity.description: Minimum cell integrity observed in the chunk this pass (0..=255).

unsupported_span_px.description: Unsupported span (in pixels) that drove the integrity decay.

unstable_cells.description: Count of cells whose integrity dropped below the L1 threshold (200).

level.description: Crack-decal level the engine should render. 'l1' is the first warning; 'l2' / 'l3' escalations are emitted as subsequent events with the higher level.

bbox.description: Optional pixel-space AABB of the affected sub-region. Omitted when the entire chunk is the affected region.

vibration_modifier.description: Vibration modifier (1.0 baseline; 2.0 plasma cutter). Echoed for replay diagnostics.
